page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal line numbers (5, 10, 15, 20, 25) stand in the right margin. A paragraph number "5. Deus" stands at the lower right below the text. Running head at the top, page number 306 at the head.

main_text.p: amplius omnia viuentia, quemadmodum feci. Deinceps quamdiu erit terra; sementis & messis, frigus q; & æstus, & æstas & hiems, dies q; & nox non cessabunt. Confer Deut.28. Psal.104. Matt. 5.v.45.c.6.v.26.30.
Act.14. v.17. Quanquam non passus est se esse expertem testimonij, bona tribuendo, dans nobis cælitus pluuias ac tempora fructibus edendis apta, implens cibo & lætitia corda nostra.5

Psalm.135.v.9. Deus immisit signa & prodigia in medium tui, Ægypte; contra Pharaonem, & feruos eius. De hac extraordinaria gubernatione vide Psal.105.106. Huc pertinent seqq. beneficia & iudicia Dei: diluuium Gen.7.verf.11. confusio Babylonica Genes.11.v.7.8.9. decem plagæ Ægypti, Exod.7.&seqq. transitus per mare rubrum Exod.14. petra percussa fundens aquam Exod.17.v.6. varia miracula in deserto, annis quadraginta Act.7.v.36. transitus per Iordanem Ios.3.v.16.17. statio solis & lunæ Ios.10.v.13. miraculosa multiplicatio farinæ, olei, panis. 1.Reg.17.v.16. Matth.14. verf.20. umbra solis retrograda 2.Reg.20.verf.10.11. conseruatio sociorum Danielis in fornace Babylonica. Dan.3. verf.24.25.26. aqua in vinum versa à Christo Iohan.2.v.8.9.10 10. & alia ipsius miracula.
4. Deus regit mundum sapienter, & valde bene.
Deut.32.verf.4. Rupis illius opus est perfectum. Omnes enim viæ illius sunt iusti: Deus fidelis, & expers iniquitatis, iustus & re-ctus est.15
Psalm.104.verf.24. Quàm ampla sunt opera tua, ô Domine! quàm ea omnia sapienter fecisti! quàm plena est terra possessio-ne tua!

Psalm.111.v.2.3.4. Magna opera Domini, expositæ omnibus, qui delectantur illis: gloriosum & decorum opus eius, & iustitiam20 eius perstantem in æternum. Memoriam comparauit mirabilium suis, gratiosus & misericors Dominus.
Et verf.7.8. Opera manuum eius sunt veritatis & iudicij: confirmantia omnia mandata eius. Confer Dan.4.v.37.
Rom.8.v.28. Nouimus, iis, qui diligunt Deum, omnia simul25 in adiumento esse ad bonum.

page.notes: The marginal line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 are read from the right margin; the position of the number 30 near the lower lines is doubtful and not transcribed. The entry "Genes.11" was printed "Genef.11" (long s read as plain s). The "Aćt" reading is taken as Act. Some marks in the margin are too faint to read and are not transcribed.
